title: Same-Visit Courtesy Amount: Workmanship Warranties Goodwill Guideline
content:
**Guideline.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the same-visit courtesy on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is the standard courtesy share of the parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before, limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge and rounded to the cent. The standard courtesy share is 0.05, that is 5 per cent.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Charges taken | The parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before the courtesy date, totalled |
| Same-visit courtesy sum | The standard courtesy share, 5 per cent, applied to the charges so booked |
| Same-visit courtesy | The same-visit courtesy sum limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge, rounded to the cent |

The same-visit courtesy is the lower of the same-visit courtesy sum and the plan's goodwill authority per charge.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Charges booked less than one whole month before | Same-visit courtesy sum | Hypothetical authority per charge | Same-visit courtesy |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 96.40 and USD 104.60, totalling USD 201.00 | USD 10.05 | USD 35.00 | USD 10.05 |
| USD 900.00 in all | USD 45.00 | USD 35.00 | USD 35.00, limited to the authority |

Q. Does a parts diagnostic charge booked six weeks before the courtesy date enter the charges taken?
A. No. Only charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before are taken.
